reviews.text: I took my dog here. And the service was incredible. Usually my dog hates being groom. But at this place my little blu was barely acting up. And the staff there was amazing too they work with you to make sure you understand everything.

I am extremely disappointed with the grooming service my dog received. The groomer, Carmen Ortiz, shaved my Shih Tzu down to the skin without regard for his appearance or comfort. She removed all of his facial hair and even his whiskers, while leaving his ears extremely long, making him look completely uneven.

What concerns me most is my dog's condition after the grooming. He has red spots from being shaved so closely and has been crying, sleeping excessively, and clearly seems uncomfortable since coming home. It is heartbreaking to see him this way.

I also spoke with the owner and manager, but neither showed any compassion or concern about what happened. Instead of addressing my concerns, I felt dismissed. As a pet owner, I trusted them to care for my dog, and I do not feel that trust was respected.

I would not recommend this grooming salon based on my experience. My dog deserved better care, attention, and consideration than he received.

I’m guessing this place gets the high ratings from its grooming services and not the animal sales operation that’s going on in-store. I personally dislike the sale of small animals in pet chain stores but what’s really disheartening is seeing how worse these small shops can be. Last week I was in contact with a lady who purchased a live animal, a hamster, from this place. I quickly learned she was not equipped to take on a hamster and what followed suit was just sad. The hamster was placed in a plastic container about the size of a shoebox and was let out on the lady’s bed. Hamster owners know full well that these animals need a lot more than that. And those are less than adequate, they’re inappropriate for how hamsters should be kept for the safety and well-being. I called this store myself, come to find out they don’t take live animals back as returns, not even when only a day has lapsed. Non-returns go against standard retail policies much less for live animals. What’s equally disappointing is this store’s inability to understand the situation. I was faced with a lady who purchased the hamster from Facebook Marketplace and when she tried to return it after realizing she was ill-equipped to take in a hamster, the store said she couldn’t return the hamster. When I explained the situation, the store manager said they couldn’t do anything about it but did offer to sell me 3 hamsters for $60. Sir, read the room. I’m sure this place offers the best bath for your dogs but please, don’t buy live animals in general much less from this store.

This is for the woman and middle aged man could be her husband I’m not sure if he’s the husband. When I first went to shop for our rescue dog I had mentioned to them that my dog likes boiled chicken. The woman said with an attitude and ugly stank face “you shouldn’t be feeding your dog boiled chicken”. The man said “you looking at expensive medical vet bills and the dog’s skin will have an allergic reaction to chicken”. This was in 2023, now fast forward 2025 we just found out our little dog was born with a liver shunt!!! Liver shunt is a very serious disease that can get out of control if not treated properly and they must eat gastrointestinal food low in fat and low in protein and that’s not a food one can get at the local pet shop or store. It’s prescribed. Also, a liver shunt dog CAN eat chicken (white chicken boiled non seasoned) due it being low fat and low in protein because liver shunt dogs diet has to be strict in low fat low protein! You are NOT a medical professional to be telling folks anything especially with the attitude you gave, now if it’s a universal advice as in something that is not a possible threat then ok. My dog’s liver enzyme was high because she was eating the wrong dog foods although they are healthy good food but it’s not for her because she needs low fat low protein. Some dogs are allergic to chicken like my friend’s dog she can’t eat chicken but my friend cooks her pork and liver and her dog is healthy and her dog doesn’t have a liver shunt!
